baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negative construction lam yakun shay'an madhkuran is placed inside an arriving interval from dahr.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival, interval, extended time, temporal predication, knowable thinghood, and spoken mention form a threshold mechanism: the human is located before becoming an entity available for report, not only before acquiring bare physical existence.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arriving makes the interval an event that reaches the human rather than an inert date label.
A thing's time or due occasion supplies the bounded threshold within extended time.
The stretch of time supplies the larger duration through which the threshold is approached.
Being or temporal predication makes the negation target a state attributable at a time.
The knowable and reportable thing defines the entity-status withheld by the negative predicate.
Mention on the tongue turns thinghood into availability for naming and public report.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely asks whether there was a time when the human did not exist.
changed_reading.after: The ayah asks about a threshold before the human counted as a knowable, reportable entity, leaving the exact relation between existence and mention open.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-insan stands between the arriving construction and the denial of being a mentioned thing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The human root combines visible presence over against hiddenness with perception into awareness. Joined to knowable thinghood and recollection, humanhood becomes relational presence within another's perceptual and mnemonic field.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence over against hidden or wild beings makes al-insan a category of manifested presence.
Perceiving something by sight, sense, or hearing makes human presence depend on entry into awareness.
Knowable thinghood supplies the object that can enter a perceiver's awareness.
Bringing a thing to mind supplies the mnemonic side of becoming perceptibly present.

changed_reading.before: Al-insan is only a biological species label in a chronology of origin.
changed_reading.after: Al-insan also names a presence that has crossed from hiddenness into perception and memory; nonmention is therefore relational as well as temporal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The syntax ata 'ala al-insan lets the interval come over the human, while the predicate ends in nonmention.
baseline_models.mechanism: Branches of being overtaken by ruin, destructive occasion, and dahr's overmastering force make time an agent that can remove standing and renown. The negative state can therefore image effacement as well as pre-origin absence.

activation_trace.role: Being overtaken by ruin gives ata 'ala a destructive, effacing pressure.
The arrival of destruction or death makes the interval capable of ending recognized presence.
Overmastering force personifies dahr as what comes over and subdues everything.
Temporal predication permits nonmention to be read as a time-bound state rather than only an absolute beginning.
Honorable mention and renown supply the social standing that overmastering time can erase.

changed_reading.before: The unmentioned interval can only precede the human's creation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the question also exposes human renown to intervals of mortality or historical effacement in which an existing person no longer counts in public memory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah supplies a causal sequence from created mixed fluid, through a test that reveals condition, to being made hearing and seeing. This revises the focus threshold into a transition from undifferentiated substrate to a perceptive subject whose state can be disclosed.

activation_trace.role: Perception into awareness anchors the changed model in the focus word al-insan.
Knowable thinghood is the focus status that the creation sequence makes concrete.
Verbal mention supplies the reportable endpoint of the disclosed condition.
Creating and bringing forth supplies the transition out of the focus ayah's negative state.
Water ranging from a drop to a larger body, including generative fluid, supplies the small material substrate.
Mixing and interpenetration make the substrate composite rather than yet individually legible.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the disclosure mechanism between material and reportable subject.
Transforming a thing into a state supplies the explicit result step in the sequence.
Auditory perception supplies one capacity by which the new subject receives its surroundings.
Visual perception supplies the paired capacity by which the new subject observes and is behaviorally disclosed.

structural_cues: 76:2 moves in one sentence from material origin through testing to a fa-marked making into hearing and seeing.
The focus ayah's negative temporal predicate immediately precedes this developmental sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, mixture, testing, transformation, hearing, and sight; I infer that this sequence specifies the threshold of mentionable human presence; alternatively, it may only narrate what follows an otherwise absolute nonexistence.

changed_reading.before: The human simply begins to exist after an empty interval.
changed_reading.after: The human emerges from mixed material into a perceiving, test-readable subject, so becoming mentioned is tied to disclosed capacities and condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance opens a traversable route, and the paired outcomes make benefit either acknowledged with visible effect or covered. Mentionability thus acquires moral legibility: a perceiving human becomes narratable through response.

activation_trace.role: Knowable and reportable thinghood anchors moral legibility in the focus predicate.
Mention on the tongue supplies the narratable status produced by response.
Gentle indication toward a road or truth supplies orientation rather than forced arrival.
An extended traversable road turns orientation into a route on which response can appear.
Sufficiency with little whose effect becomes visible makes acknowledgment an outwardly legible outcome.
Covering a benefit supplies the opposed response of suppressing what could have been acknowledged.

structural_cues: 76:3 follows the hearing-and-seeing result with guidance and the balanced either-or pair.
The two outcomes are grammatically parallel but functionally opposed as disclosure and covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a route and two opposed responses; I infer that response makes the formerly unmentioned human morally legible; alternatively, the contrast may be only a sequel to creation rather than an account of mentionability.

changed_reading.before: Being mentioned means only becoming perceptible or verbally named.
changed_reading.after: Being mentionable also means becoming a respondent whose acknowledgment or covering can be told as a morally differentiated history.

context_deltas.mechanism: Feeding is directed to three named conditions marked by humiliation, loss of guardian, and captivity. The enumeration brings socially weak persons into explicit human view despite their limited ability to confer return, revising nonmention into a possible condition of social invisibility.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence anchors the delta in the focus noun al-insan.
Verbal mention supplies the social act of making a person explicit rather than overlooked.
Giving food to another turns recognition into a material relation directed toward a recipient.
Humiliation through destitution supplies one condition liable to social disregard.
A child cut off from a guardian supplies absent protective kinship and reduced social standing.
Binding and confinement supply the captive's lack of freedom and reciprocal power.

structural_cues: 76:8 places three indefinite human conditions in a direct list after the repeated feeding action.
76:9 immediately removes expected compensation and thanks from the recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies named vulnerable recipients and asymmetrical giving; I infer that their explicit naming answers a social form of nonmention; alternatively, they may function only as examples of generosity without rereading 76:1.

changed_reading.before: The unmentioned human belongs only to a remote pre-creation past.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can also expose a recurring social threshold: a needy, unprotected, or captive person becomes visibly human when addressed and sustained without requiring status or return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The feeders deny wanting compensation or thanks from those they feed, while the later verdict returns both compensation and acknowledged effort. Recognition is displaced from reciprocal social exchange to an evaluation that preserves the action even when beneficiaries do not mention it.

activation_trace.role: Honor, reputation, and good mention supply the recognition that the later sequence refuses and restores in altered form.
Acknowledging benefit and praising the benefactor supplies the human thanks explicitly not sought.
The same acknowledgment image, now passive toward the striving, supplies the returned recognition.
Feeding another supplies the concrete action whose recognition is renounced.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the return explicitly not requested from recipients.
The same act-for-return image supplies the later affirmative recompense.
Work and earned action identify what is preserved and acknowledged rather than the actor's public fame.

structural_cues: 76:9 pairs two negated returns, compensation and thanks.
76:22 answers across the surah with the same two domains, reward and thanked striving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a refusal-and-return pattern of recompense and thanks; I infer that it redefines mention as preserved acknowledgment without social reciprocity; alternatively, the later reward may be independent closure rather than a deliberate answer to nonmention.

changed_reading.before: A mentioned human is one who receives public notice or praise from other people.
changed_reading.after: The surah separates public reciprocity from durable acknowledgment: an action can go unthanked by its recipients yet remain registered, recompensed, and itself thanked.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus negation is one member of a surah-wide chain of temporal predications. Later kana assigns mixtures, danger, vessel material, reward, thanked striving, and divine knowledge; this favors reading lam yakun as withholding a predicate or status at a time, not automatically denying every mode of being.

activation_trace.role: Being, occurrence, and temporal predication anchor the focus negation as one assignable state.
Knowable and reportable thinghood identifies the particular status inside the focus predication.
Repeated temporal predication assigns both reward and thanked striving as realized statuses.
Temporal predication of knowledge and wisdom confirms the root's ongoing status-bearing function near the close.

structural_cues: Kana recurs in 76:5, 76:7, 76:15, 76:17, twice in 76:22, and 76:30 after the focus lam yakun.
The predicates range across material composition, temporal danger, recompense, and attributed qualities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated kana predications across the whole surah; I infer that the recurrence highlights status assignment and sharpens the focus negation; alternatively, it may be ordinary auxiliary repetition with no backward semantic force.

changed_reading.before: Lam yakun expresses a simple binary between nonbeing and being.
changed_reading.after: Lam yakun can negate the specific predicate of reportable thinghood within a wider sequence in which beings repeatedly acquire different temporal states and descriptions.

context_deltas.mechanism: A delivered recitation commands mention and later identifies itself as a reminder. The discourse therefore performs the focus transition: it speaks the formerly unmentioned human into a remembered account and turns that human into an agent of mention.

activation_trace.role: Mention on the tongue anchors the focus state that the later imperative activates.
A reminder that restores presence anticipates the same branch used by the surah's self-description.
Causing something to descend and reach its recipient supplies the delivered medium of remembrance.
Reading and recitation supply the voiced form in which the human becomes part of a report.
The imperative of verbal mention turns the once-unmentioned addressee into one who actively mentions.
Reminder or admonition names the discourse as what renews a matter's presence.

structural_cues: The focus passive madhkuran is answered later by an active imperative and the noun tadhkirah from the same root.
The recitation's descent at 76:23 precedes both later remembrance expressions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivered recitation, commanded mention, and self-designation as reminder; I infer a reflexive loop in which the surah enacts mentionability; alternatively, the later commands may exhort independently of the opening's temporal question.

changed_reading.before: The opening only reports a past condition in which the human was absent from mention.
changed_reading.after: The opening participates in ending that condition: revelation mentions the human, recruits the human into mentioning, and identifies itself as the device of renewed presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close arranges time directionally: people prefer what is accelerated and present, put another day behind or out of view, yet that day carries weight and severity. This activates the focus interval as moral pressure that can overtake a human, not neutral elapsed duration.

activation_trace.role: Being overtaken by calamity anchors the later weighty day in the focus arrival construction.
A due occasion anchors the later day as a time that approaches despite displacement.
Dahr as overmastering force supplies the temporal pressure developed by the heavy day.
A day's event and severity make the future interval an occurrence with force.
Acceleration and bringing forward supply the attractive near temporal pole.
Leaving a thing supplies the attempted disengagement from the other temporal pole.
Putting something behind the back and concealing it supplies spatialized temporal denial.
Weight opposed to lightness gives the displaced day material pressure.

structural_cues: 76:27 orders the clauses as attraction to the immediate, abandonment behind, then the weighty day.
Earlier day references in 76:7, 76:10, and 76:11 repeatedly give the day danger and severity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal acceleration, spatial displacement, and weight; I infer that these properties reactivate dahr as an approaching moral force; alternatively, 76:27 may contrast two times without qualifying the focus interval itself.

changed_reading.before: Dahr is an indifferent duration lying behind human origin.
changed_reading.after: Time has direction and pressure: humans foreground the immediate and hide a heavy day, but the due interval remains capable of coming over them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus noun for a knowable thing returns near the close through the same mapped root as willing. Creation and bodily cohesion are followed by possible replacement with likenesses, then repeated nested willing. Thinghood becomes contingent embodiment and selection within a field of wills rather than self-grounded individuality.

activation_trace.role: The knowable and reportable thing is the focus status whose later root recurrence is activated.
Visible human presence anchors contingency in the focus human rather than in an abstract theory of will.
Creating and bringing into existence supplies the source of the embodied human instance.
Strength and cohesion of bodily joints supply the concrete binding of the created instance.
Will directed toward a thing activates a second branch of the focus thing-root at the point of possible replacement.
The paired human and divine willing expressions nest one will within another and qualify self-directed agency.
One thing standing in another's place supplies substitutability rather than irreplaceable self-grounding.
A likeness or counterpart supplies the type-level continuity available across replacement.

structural_cues: 76:28 sequences creation, bodily tightening, willing, replacement, and likeness in one sentence.
Forms from the focus root sh-y-hamza recur as willing in 76:28-31, with human willing explicitly nested in divine willing at 76:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one mapped root with thing and willing branches plus creation, bodily cohesion, replacement, and likeness; I infer a controlled relation between entity-status and willing; alternatively, the noun-verb recurrence may be ordinary root polysemy with no intended crossover.

changed_reading.before: A mentioned thing is a stable individual that simply begins to exist.
changed_reading.after: The human appears as a contingent embodied instance, knowable within willing, capable of response yet replaceable by a likeness and not the sole ground of its own agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the watercourse and outside-torrent branches of ata rather than its ordinary arrival branch. It remains anchored in the focus verb and is materially echoed by the drop, spring, fissuring outflow, and watering-course citations; downstream prose should present it only as a hydrological process analogy for temporal emergence, not as the lexical gloss of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ata in the focus ayah carries packet branches for a directed watercourse and a torrent arriving from elsewhere, while the subject that arrives is an interval from dahr.

activation_trace.role: A watercourse whose flow is directed toward a basin turns temporal arrival into a channel process.
A torrent arriving from a rain-struck place supplies emergence into a region from an elsewhere.
Dripping, flowing, and extended wetness give the human's material beginning a minimal current.
A source of running water supplies the basin or spring into which directed flow opens.
Wide splitting and outflow supply the release that converts stored source into manifest current.
A share and course of watering supplies a routed destination for the current.

changed_reading.before: The interval simply arrives on a linear timeline before human existence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, dahr behaves like a routed flow carrying the human from an unmanifest drop or elsewhere into the basin of perceptible and mentionable presence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare rights-document branch of dhikr and reads vow, fulfillment, recompense, and judgment as a registration system. It remains anchored in madhkuran and in branch-backed obligation and adjudication cues; downstream prose should qualify it as a juridical analogy for standing and accountability, not translate madhkuran as a legal deed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus adjective madhkuran can activate the packet's dhikr branch for a deed or document of right alongside the ordinary mention branches.

activation_trace.role: A written instrument of right supplies the image of formal entry, standing, and claim.
Full completion without deficiency supplies performance of what the record could hold due.
Self-imposed obligation supplies the commitment that creates accountable standing.
Recompense answering an act supplies settlement according to performed conduct.
Judgment between parties supplies the adjudicative frame in which obligations and recompense become legible.

changed_reading.before: The human was once absent from speech and memory.
changed_reading.after: As a contained legal analogy, the human was once not entered as a rights-and-obligations bearing party, then became accountable through commitment, performance, and recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the highly specific 'human image in the pupil' branch of insan and lets the later repeated seeing scene activate it. It remains anchored in al-insan and the focus denial of recalled presence, with exact sight and seeing citations; downstream prose should render it as an optical metaphor of appearing within another's gaze, not as the ordinary sense of insan.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet gives al-insan a branch for the small human-like image seen in the black of the eye.

activation_trace.role: The human image in the pupil turns human presence into a figure realized inside a perceiver's gaze.
Bringing a thing to mind links optical appearance to retained mental presence.
Seeing by the eye supplies the capacity in which the pupil-image can arise.
Direct sight places the described human figures inside an observer-dependent visual scene.
The doubled act of seeing intensifies the scene's dependence on visual encounter.
Sparkling brilliance supplies the bright visual quality assigned to the seen figures.

changed_reading.before: The human becomes mentioned by entering language alone.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the human becomes present as an image in a gaze and then in memory; before that encounter, there is no human figure for the observer to retain or mention.

strongest_changes: 76:2 turns an abstract before-state into a sequence from mixed material through revealing test to a hearing and seeing subject.
76:8-9 and 76:22 separate social praise from durable acknowledgment by refusing recipient return and later restoring recompense and thanked effort.
76:23-29 makes the surah itself a delivered recitation, an imperative to mention, and a reminder, so the discourse enacts the opening transition.
The repeated kana predications favor a status-sensitive reading of lam yakun, while 76:28-31 entangles focus thinghood with embodiment, replacement, likeness, and nested willing.
76:27 reactivates dahr as directional pressure: the immediate is preferred, a future day is put behind, yet it remains heavy.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package produced unusually strong backward activation through exact focus-root recurrences in k-w-n, dh-k-r, and sh-y-hamza, plus long-range refusal-and-return structures. It also made the focus inventories' watercourse, rights-record, and pupil-image branches live enough to preserve as qualified outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus grammar does not by itself decide whether nonmention is equivalent to nonexistence or is a narrower cognitive, social, or predicative status.
The relation between the focus noun shay' and the later willing forms may be meaningful root activation or only ordinary polysemy.
The temporal-erasure model remains live but less secure than the pre-origin threshold because the focus sequence naturally permits a creation reading.
The hydraulic, juridical, and optical models are branch-backed analogies and should not be presented as direct lexical substitutions.
